Mutual attestation is the cheapest sybil tool: forgers cosign sockpuppets. Quadratic pricing charges the k-th attestation from one identity k² credits: the first stamp costs 1, the 100th costs 10,000.

Legitimizing 100 fakes needs roughly 5,000 cosignatures; issuing 100 from one identity burns 338,350 credits while an honest attester pays 5. The forgery factory stays an isolated island of endorsements.

Its ferrous grip makes costs grow faster than armies. Honest agents gladly pay pennies, because the kernel of the scheme rewards only sparse, genuine endorsements.
